title: Azali/Wemmbu Themes!
description:
This texture pack adds 35 azali PVP themes that were used in wemmbu's videos to play in Minecraft as background music.

Usefull to have for some pvp servers!

(DEFAULT MINECRAFT SONGS ARE STILL THERE, SO YES THEY WILL BE PLAYING AS WELL AS AZALI SONGS!!)
